commands: GITHUB_TOKEN=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id esafx/staging/github-clone --region "$REGION" --query SecretString --output text)
docker compose -f deploy/staging/docker-compose.app.yml build crm-api whatsapp-gateway
docker compose -f deploy/staging/docker-compose.app.yml run --rm crm-migrate || true
for i in $(seq 1 24); do docker exec esafx-whatsapp-gateway curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8007/health && break || sleep 5; done
docker exec esafx-whatsapp-gateway curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8007/health && echo GW_OK
docker exec esafx-crm-api curl -sf http://whatsapp-gateway:8007/health && echo CRM_TO_GW_OK
docker exec esafx-whatsapp-gateway curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8007/health/whatsapp || true
